# Earvin Laureano, Digital Systems Builder

> Earvin Laureano is a freelance digital systems builder based in the Philippines, working with clients worldwide. He builds conversion-focused websites, sales and lead funnels, and the automation and AI that tie a growing business together. Builds ship fast and are optimized for both Google and AI search.

Earvin offers a small, focused set of services, priced up front. Project work starts with a non-refundable 50% booking payment, with the balance due on completion. Work is protected by the Sign-Off Guarantee: the build is refined within the agreed revision rounds until it meets scope and the client signs off. All sales are final; the protection is the sign-off, not a refund. Contact: inquire@earvinlaureano.com. Remote, worldwide.

## Services
- [Websites](https://www.earvinlaureano.com/websites): Custom, fast, AI-search-ready websites built to turn visitors into booked clients. Founding rate from $1,797.
- [Funnels](https://www.earvinlaureano.com/funnels): Multi-page conversion funnels with strategy, copy, design, and build included. Founding rate from $1,497.
- [Partnership](https://www.earvinlaureano.com/services): An ongoing monthly retainer where Earvin runs operations and the digital side as a right hand. From $1,997 per month, never billed by the hour.
- [Pricing](https://www.earvinlaureano.com/pricing): All the ways to work together, with clear pricing.
